rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for a repeating pattern of bands or a single coloured band.

example.english: This shirt has a blue stripe.
example.traditional: 呢件衫有一條藍色條紋。

rows.note: Use this when the stripe functions as a rank badge in a military or similar force.

example.english: The soldier has a stripe sewn onto his shoulder.
example.traditional: 軍人嘅肩膀上面縫住一塊軍階章。
